activity_statements.statement: operates discount specialty retail stores selling trendy, affordable merchandise primarily priced at or below $5 (and some items up to $25 via Five Beyond), targeting teens, tweens, and value-seeking families
sells products across categories including Toys & Games, Style (apparel and accessories), Room (home decor), Tech, Beauty, Arts & Crafts, Candy & Snacks, Sports, Books, and Pet Supplies
sells licensed brand merchandise from partners including Disney, Pokemon, SpongeBob, Bluey, Hello Kitty, and Funko in a discount retail format
curates trend-right merchandise on rapid buying cycles, refreshing store assortments frequently to match youth and seasonal trends
operates 1,600+ stores in the US with in-store and online pickup options for customers

name_reality_gap: The name 'Five Below' implies all items are $5 or less; the company has meaningfully expanded its 'Five Beyond' section selling items up to $25, blurring its original one-price identity. The 'Retail' index label is accurate but misses the youth-trend-and-licensed-character positioning that distinguishes Five Below from general discounters.
extraction_notes: corporate.fivebelow.com/about timed out repeatedly; fivebelow.com homepage provided product category evidence but limited corporate operational detail. Store count and Five Beyond detail sourced from publicly known information. Extraction confidence reduced due to source limitations.
